meta.name: gstack-investigate
meta.description: GStack investigation method for bugs, incidents, failing tests, regressions, and unclear behavior where evidence and root cause should precede fixes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 系统化调查缺陷、故障和回归问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在修复前先找到问题的根本原因
copy.tagline_en: Systematically investigate bugs, incidents, and regressions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find root causes before fixing issues

howto.what: 当遇到 bug、测试失败或回归问题时，Claude 会先收集证据、分析根因，再给出最小修复方案和验证计划，而不是直接改代码。
howto.when: 当你描述一个 bug、测试失败或回归问题，且根因未知时触发。也可以直接说“$gstack-investigate”来调用。

say.text: 这个测试一直失败，帮我用 gstack 调查一下。
say.note: Claude 会按流程产出证据和根因分析。

say.text: $gstack-investigate 为什么用户登录后页面崩溃？
say.note: 直接触发调查模式，输出根因和修复路径。

howto.what_en: When encountering a bug, failing test, or regression, Claude first gathers evidence, analyzes root cause, then produces a minimal fix and verification plan instead of directly modifying code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you describe a bug, failing test, or regression with unknown root cause. Also invoked by saying "$gstack-investigate".

say_en.text: This test keeps failing. Investigate it with gstack.
say_en.note: Claude will output evidence and root cause analysis.

say_en.text: $gstack-investigate Why does the login page crash?
say_en.note: Directly triggers investigation mode, outputs root cause and fix path.
